column1: # Microsoft's ONNX Runtime builds that Photostacker loads at run time, one per system (spec §8.3).
# scripts/ort.sh and scripts/win.ps1 read it; a test in crates/core/src/models/embed.rs checks it.
# Tab-separated: os (uname -s, as linux, macos or windows), arch (uname -m, as x86_64 or aarch64), version,
# and the library's path inside the folder the archive unpacks to (the archive's name without .tgz or .zip).
# Microsoft publishes no Intel macOS build after 1.23.2, and 1.19.2 is the newest one that runs on macOS 11.
